stories.title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI had some problems sharing math research that caused embarrassment, so now they're asking expert mathematicians to help them handle this better in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect everyday people or small business owners — it's about how a big company manages its scientific work.

stories.title: Big tech says AI can find a cure for cancer. So where is it?
stories.simple_summary: Big technology companies say AI might help find cures for cancer, but the article points out that actual cures haven't shown up yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly hype from companies trying to look good — don't expect AI cancer cures to help you or your business anytime soon, though research is ongoing.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit’s agenda revealed: Unlock fundraising, hiring, and AI insights in Boston on November 4
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is holding a business conference in Boston where startup founders can learn about fundraising and AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you're planning to start a tech company — otherwise it's just an event for other business owners.

stories.title: Opinion | Cartoon by Mike Smith
stories.simple_summary: This is just a cartoon, not a news story.

stories.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms
stories.simple_summary: A company called Snorkel AI, which helps train AI systems with data, just became worth $3.5 billion and raised $350 million in funding.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows AI companies need lots of training data, but it doesn't directly affect small business owners.

stories.title: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run
stories.simple_summary: Rabbit, a company that makes AI helper software, released a version you can use on your regular Windows or Mac computer without buying their special hardware device.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're interested in trying AI assistants, this gives you another option to download and test, though it's still mostly for tech-comfortable people.

stories.title: Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI
stories.simple_summary: Qualcomm made new smartphone chips that can run AI programs directly on the phone itself, rather than sending everything to the cloud.
stories.why_it_matters: This means future smartphones will handle AI tasks faster and privately, which could make AI features more useful in everyday phone apps.

stories.title: I Gave My Life Over to Meta’s A.I. Agent and Was Blown Away
stories.simple_summary: A reporter tried using Meta's new AI assistant and was impressed by how well it worked.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just one person's opinion — wait to see what most users think before deciding if it's worth trying.

stories.title: Meta admits Muse’s likeness to OpenClaw isn’t a coincidence
stories.simple_summary: Meta created an AI assistant called Muse that looks very similar to another company's assistant called OpenClaw, and Meta admits it copied the design heavily.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and lawyers — it shows big tech companies sometimes copy each other's ideas.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released two new AI models that cost less money to use and make fewer mistakes than their older versions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use OpenAI's services for your business, you might save money and get better results, but most small business owners should first try free or cheaper AI tools to see if they actually help your work.

stories.title: Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta
stories.simple_summary: A big investment company is creating a school and training program to help young people start tech companies, working with partners like Google, Meta, and OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to young people interested in starting tech startups — nothing you need to act on as a small business owner.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5.5 that works really well and costs less than their previous version.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Anthropic's AI for business tasks, you might get better results for less money, but most small businesses should try free AI tools first to understand if AI actually helps your specific work.
